responsibility: Defines the canonical <stdint.h> type mappings for FreeBSD targets. It supplies exact-width, least-width, fast-width, intptr_t/uintptr_t, and sig_atomic_t type spellings according to the FreeBSD ABI and LONG_TYPE_SIZE. The header’s role is limited to stdint type-model selection, separate from FreeBSD specs, builtins, or driver options.
